scripts.backup:schedule: cp scripts/com.skyfire.collection-backup.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && (launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.skyfire.collection-backup.plist 2>/dev/null; launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.skyfire.collection-backup.plist) && echo 'Daily backup scheduled (21:00, see /tmp/skyfire-backup.log)'
scripts.checkpoint: node -e "require('./scripts/pre-commit.js').checkpointDatabase(); console.log('WAL checkpoint done, sessions cleared, ready to commit');"
scripts.lint: eslint server.js src/ lib/ scripts/ backup.js gc-uploads.js pull.js test/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix server.js src/ lib/ scripts/ backup.js gc-uploads.js pull.js test/
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/middleware.js && node --check src/helpers.js && node --check src/db.js && node --check src/errors.js && node -e "['src/routes','scripts'].forEach(dir=>require('fs').readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f=>{require('child_process').execFileSync('node',['--check',dir+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit',encoding:'utf8'});console.log(dir+'/'+f+': OK')}))" && node --check lib/validate.js && node --check backup.js && node --check gc-uploads.js && node --check pull.js
